summary: Petrobras filed a Form 6-K furnishing its second-quarter 2026 tax report on a cash basis. The report details R$161 billion in taxes and government take paid in the first half of 2026, including R$106.1 billion from own operations, R$37.2 billion in government take (royalties, special participation, signature bonuses, area fees), and R$17.7 billion in taxes withheld from third parties. Federal contributions rose 28% year-over-year, partially due to a new export tax on crude oil established by Provisional Measure No. 1,340 in March 2026. This is a routine disclosure of tax payments, not a special situation.
